    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersExtra crunchy puffed rice noodlesRice vermicelli fried until puffed, with chilli flakes and sea saltHow to make it200g rice vermicelli500ml vegetable oil, for frying1 tsp chilli flakes1 tsp sea salt flakes2 limes4 lettuce leavesHeat the oil to 190°C.Drop in small handfuls of dry vermicelli so they puff up instantly.Drain and toss with chilli flakes, sea salt and a squeeze of lime.Pile onto a lettuce leaf and serve.Rafiki's fruit platterRockmelon, papaya, mango and passionfruit with lime and chilli saltHow to make it1 rockmelon1/2 papaya2 mangoes3 passionfruits2 limes1 tsp salt1/4 tsp chilli powderCut the rockmelon, papaya and mangoes into wedges.Arrange on a platter with halved passionfruit.Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with chilli salt.Pride Rock beef samosas with mint yoghurtZazu says this is not a drillHow to make itAs written, serves 4Spiced beef mince with onion, peas and garam masala folded into pastry triangles, fried until crisp, with mint yoghurt.Fry 1 diced onion in oil until soft, add 400g beef mince, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin and 2 grated garlic cloves and cook 8 minutes.Stir in 1 cup frozen peas and season, then cool.Cut 6 sheets spring roll pastry into 3 long strips each, fold a spoonful of filling into triangles and seal with flour paste.Fry at 180°C for 3 minutes until crisp.Stir chopped mint and a squeeze of lemon into 200g Greek yoghurt for dipping.Vetkoek with apricot jamUmami, says Timon. Jam, not grubs.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsJungle hideaway chickenChicken thighs marinated in homemade chilli peri peri sauce and grilledHow to make it1kg chicken thighs3 red chillies2 lemons4 garlic cloves2 tsp smoked paprika60ml olive oil1 tsp salt300g long grain rice1/2 tsp ground turmericBlitz the chillies, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, oil and salt into a peri peri sauce.Marinate the chicken in the sauce.Grill until charred and cooked through.Cook the rice with the turmeric.Serve together.Pride Lands braai rump with pap and relishProtect everything the light touches.How to make itAs written, serves 4Beef rump steaks rubbed with paprika, coriander and garlic, grilled over coals, sliced with pap and a tomato and onion relish.Rub 800g rump steak with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp ground coriander, 2 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt and stand 30 minutes.For the relish, fry 2 sliced onions until soft, add 4 chopped tomatoes and a pinch of chilli and simmer 15 minutes.Whisk 250g white maize meal into 1L salted boiling water and stir over low heat for 20 minutes until thick, then beat in 30g butter.Grill the steak over hot coals 4 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice over the pap with relish.SweetsMufasa's malva puddingBaked apricot jam sponge, soaked while hotHow to make it2 eggs200g caster sugar, for the pudding1 tbsp apricot jam150g self-raising flour30g butter, melted, for the pudding250ml milk250ml thickened cream100g butter, for the sauce100g caster sugar, for the sauce500ml custardBeat the eggs with the caster sugar for the pudding and the jam.Fold in the flour, melted butter and milk.Pour into a baking dish and bake at 180°C.Heat the cream with the butter and sugar for the sauce until melted.Pour the hot sauce over the pudding and let it soak in.Warm the custard and serve alongside.DrinksWatering hole peach rooibos iced teaRooibos tea steeped with orange peel and honey, with peach, chilledHow to make it4 rooibos tea bags1 orange1 L boiling water3 tbsp honey2 ripe peaches4 sprigs of mint250ml sparkling water4 cups iceSteep the tea bags and orange peel in the just-boiled water.Remove the bags and peel and stir in the honey.Chill the tea.Slice the peaches.Fill tall glasses with ice and peaches, pour in the tea and top with sparkling water and a mint sprig.Homemade ginger beer with limeRafiki shakes it, like the
